Team — putting some concrete options on the table for Dedicated capacity and pilot mechanics. See attached spreadsheet (stub) with three options and the downstream impacts:

Option A — 30-day pilot on shared infra w/ soft capacity guarantee
- Low upfront cost to Redwood; limited isolation. Good for speed.
- Pros: fastest to start. Cons: weaker contractual SLOs.

Option B — Time-boxed Dedicated pool (30 days) with provisional credit
- Spin a small Dedicated pool (2 A100 equiv) for 30 days; Redwood covers 50% of cost as a pilot credit.
- Pros: demonstrable latency SLO; Cons: impacts short-term margin, requires ops time to provision.

Option C — Full reserved capacity commit (90 days min) with standard pricing
- Best for long-term economics / SLO.

Ask: if the preferred path is Option B (recommended to win the deal and speed procurement), I need executive approval for a one-time pilot credit and for a fast-track provisioning ticket with Ops (CC’ing Vivek to confirm provisioning lead time). If approvals are green I’ll prepare the redlines for the pilot SOW and fill the Dedicated_capacity_options.xlsx with expected costs.
